theorems.name: Submission.regcomp_smooth_cutoff_product
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ), ∃ c₀ : ℝ, 0 ≤ c₀ ∧ ∀ (J : ℕ) (p : Fin J → Euclid P) (σ : Fin J → ℝ), (∀ j, 0 < σ j) → ∃ ζ : Euclid P → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) ζ ∧ (∀ x, 0 ≤ ζ x ∧ ζ x ≤ 1) ∧ (∀ j, ∀ x ∈ ball (p j) (σ j), ζ x = 0) ∧ (∀ x, 1 - ζ x ≤ ∑ j, (ball (p j) (2 * σ j)).indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) x) ∧ ∀ x, ‖fderiv ℝ ζ x‖ ≤ ∑ j, (ball (p j) (2 * σ j)).indicator (fun _ => c₀ / σ j) x
